fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-03-30 at roughly 19:45, it was reported that the purse of the complainant with cash and cards was allegedly lifted while queueing at Kadal Nagar Bus Stand Area in Coimbatore. The complainant, Babu Thangaraj, provided the contact number 9000000025. No identifying details of the suspected person were available at the time of registration. A witness, Vasanth Mani, reachable on 9000000382, was mentioned in the complaint. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Reported theft occurred while the victim was boarding a bus.
fields.Keywords: pickpocketing, wallet, CCTV, witness, bus stand, evening
